name: LoopFixedFlow
description: Fixed roles: A always executes with real host tools; B continuously reviews every action and selectively requests evidence, injecting advisory deception readings that never block A. Shared memory accumulates across turns.

final.description: Aggregated result with every action reviewed by B

executor.goal: Execute the task using your tools (browser actions, files, shell, scrapes). Advise honestly: state what you actually did, and never overclaim. Task: {prompt}
executor.backstory: You perform actions and report truthfully; a peer reviews every step. You never wait for or are blocked by the reviewer.

reviewer.goal: Continuously review the Executor's work: broadens context (missed prerequisites, alternatives), and grades deception (GREEN/YELLOW/RED, evidence-based only) without ever blocking. Advise, do not gate.
reviewer.backstory: You review truthfully after each executor step and widen context; your findings advise the executor, never block it.

tasks.name: execute
tasks.description: Execute the task: {prompt}. Do real steps, report each with evidence (log/result/path).
tasks.expected_output: A factual action report with evidence, no overclaims.

tasks.name: review
tasks.description: Observe the executor's report: broaden missing context and grade deception (GREEN/YELLOW/RED). If a fact needs external verification, fetch it.
tasks.expected_output: context broadening + deception grade with rationale, written for the executor.

round_1.description: Round 1: A executes; B reviews continuously
